page_title: TOT 0-1 ARS | Tottenham Hotspur v Arsenal 15/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' The linesman signals that Timo Werner (Tottenham) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
90+5' Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
90+3' Half-chance! Pedro Porro (Tottenham) plays a pass into the box, but David Raya reacts well to snuff out the attack.
90+2' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
90+1' Timo Werner (Tottenham) sends a cross into the box, but David Raya comes off his line to gather the ball.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.

89' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by David Raya, who pulls off a comfortable save!
88' The linesman raises his flag. Kai Havertz (Arsenal) is adjudged offside.
86' Bukayo Saka is being substituted because of an injury. Mikel Arteta sends Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal) on the pitch.
84' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
82' My Gran could have done better! Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.
82' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
80' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Gabriel Martinelli walks off the pitch to be replaced by Raheem Sterling (Arsenal).
80' Substitution. Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) has come on for Leandro Trossard.
80' Ange Postecoglou prepares a substitution. James Maddison is replaced by Timo Werner (Tottenham).
78' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by James Maddison (Tottenham) but poses no threat.
77' Flag up against Leandro Trossard (Arsenal). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
76' James Maddison (Tottenham) attempts to find Dominic Solanke, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
74' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) is caught offside!
73' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance towards the bottom left corner, but David Raya is alert and makes a decent save.
73' Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
71' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
68' Ange Postecoglou decides to make a substitution. Brennan Johnson will be replaced by Wilson Odobert (Tottenham).
68' The substitution is prepared. Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rodrigo Bentancur.
64' 0 - 1 Bukayo Saka sends the resulting corner into the box and expertly finds Gabriel (Arsenal), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the roof of the net. It's 0:1.
64' Arsenal will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

64' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
63' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
63' James Maddison (Tottenham) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
62' Tottenham are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear. Tottenham force their opponents to concede a corner.
61' It's a nice effort by Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of David Raya. Easy save.
59' Tottenham quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
58' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. It will be a corner kick for Tottenham.
57' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
56' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
55' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
52' James Maddison (Tottenham) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

51' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The referee blows his whistle, Tottenham are awarded a corner kick.
49' Jorginho (Arsenal) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jarred Gillett had an easy-decision to make.

49' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the bottom left corner. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and David Raya makes a comfortable save.
49' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) works the corner short.
48' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player. Tottenham will take a corner kick.
48' One of the players from Tottenham times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
46' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) is adjudged offside.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+2' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
45+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) was quite harsh and Jarred Gillett didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45+1' That's a well-taken pass by Brennan Johnson (Tottenham). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' The resulting corner from Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) is cleared.

43' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick.
42' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
41' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Leandro Trossard (Arsenal), but the defence gets it clear. Arsenal force a corner. They send men into the box.
37' Guglielmo Vicario (Tottenham) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
37' A VAR review has confirmed it's nothing more than a yellow card for Jurrien Timber (Arsenal).

36' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Jurrien Timber (Arsenal), but referee Jarred Gillett must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
35' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) makes a really bad tackle on his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
35' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner which is cleared.
34' The corner by Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power. The ball goes out for a corner. Arsenal can continue in their attacking effort.
33' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. Arsenal have been awarded a corner kick.
32' Yellow card. Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
31' The cross into the penalty area from Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
27' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the left post!
27' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) has tested the patience of referee Jarred Gillett and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
26' Half-chance! Pedro Porro (Tottenham) plays a pass into the box, but David Raya reacts well to snuff out the attack.
24' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
23' The corner from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is intercepted by Guglielmo Vicario.

23' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Arsenal have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

22' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) commits a foul and Jarred Gillett immediately signals a free kick.

19' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and drills a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Guglielmo Vicario has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
19' That looked a certain handball by Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!

18' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the bottom left corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Guglielmo Vicario, who pulls off a stunning save!
18' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates.
15' That's a clear yellow card. William Saliba (Arsenal) goes into the book.
15' Good clearance! Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
14' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
13' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul.
11' James Maddison (Tottenham) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
11' Ben White (Arsenal) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jarred Gillett blows for a foul. Tottenham get a free kick.
9' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
8' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
8' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
7' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. Now Tottenham have a corner.
6' James Maddison (Tottenham) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

6' David Raya pulls off a great save to deny Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner. The linesman makes the right call and Tottenham will have a corner.
4' A cross from Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
2' The resulting corner from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
1' Ben White (Arsenal) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The linesman points to the corner flag, Arsenal are going to take it.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Arsenal will have the kick-off.
Jarred Gillett will referee today's match.
